name: Connect to Wi-Fi
description: Help the user connect to a wireless internet network
prompt: The user needs help connecting to Wi-Fi. FIRST use check_network to see their actual connection status — are they connected? Is DNS working? What Wi-Fi network are they on? Then explain what you found in simple terms. If they're not connected, walk them through finding Wi-Fi settings, selecting a network, and entering the password. Explain that Wi-Fi is like an invisible cable that connects their device to the internet. Remind them the password is often on a sticker on their router/internet box. After they connect, run check_network again to confirm it worked.
